one_line: Last great Hoysala king who resisted Yadava, Pandya and Sultanate pressures across Karnataka and Tamil regions.

appearance.age_look: late 40s to early 50s, tall and broad-shouldered with a seasoned warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache connecting to a short beard along the jawline, intense almond-shaped eyes with thick brows, default expression calm but resolute and battle-hardened
appearance.hair: black hair pulled back into a high, neatly bound warrior’s knot at the back of the crown, no loose strands, topped with a modest gold Hoysala-style cylindrical crown-band (mukuta) featuring simple incised patterns and a small central leaf-shaped ornament
appearance.costume: era-accurate Hoysala royal-warrior attire: a fitted, short-sleeved deep maroon tunic (angiya) reaching mid-thigh and belted at the waist, worn over cream-coloured cotton trousers that taper at the ankle; a rich dark green silk dhoti-style lower drape wrapped over the trousers and pleated to fall cleanly to the ankles, secured with a wide gold cloth girdle; over the tunic, a sleeveless steel-grey chainmail vest visible at shoulders and torso; a long mustard-gold silk shawl (uttariya) with subtle floral borders draped from left shoulder across chest and around the back; simple steel armguards on forearms, and leather sandals with toe straps; jewellery kept martial yet royal: medium-width gold necklace with small pendant, two gold armlets high on biceps with Hoysala-style scrollwork, and small round gold stud earrings.
appearance.signature: a straight, broad Hoysala-style steel sword with a simple disc pommel and slightly flared crossguard, carried sheathed at his left hip in a brown leather scabbard with subtle gold fittings, right hand often resting on the hilt in a ready but composed stance

ref_desc: Veera Ballala III is a tall, broad-shouldered, medium-brown king with a warrior’s knot under a gold crown-band, maroon tunic, cream trousers, dark green dhoti drape, mustard-gold shawl, chainmail vest, gold armlets and a sheathed broad steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Veera Ballala III as a dignified late-40s Hoysala king-warrior: medium-brown complexion, oval face with strong jaw, straight nose, intense almond eyes, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, and black hair pulled into a high, tidy warrior’s knot. On his head sits a modest cylindrical gold crown-band with simple engraved patterns and a small leaf-shaped front ornament. He wears a fitted, short-sleeved deep maroon tunic belted at the waist over cream cotton trousers that taper to the ankle, covered by a dark green silk dhoti-like drape wrapped and pleated to the ankles, secured with a wide gold cloth girdle. Over his torso is a sleeveless steel-grey chainmail vest, and a long mustard-gold silk shawl with subtle floral borders is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back. Add steel armguards on his forearms, leather sandals, a medium-width gold necklace, gold armlets on his upper arms, and small round gold stud earrings. At his left hip hangs a straight, broad steel sword in a brown leather scabbard with gold fittings, his right hand often resting on the hilt. Show him from multiple angles, emphasizing the consistent crown-band, warrior’s knot, maroon tunic, green dhoti drape, mustard-gold shawl, chainmail vest, and sword, with a calm yet resolute expression and a heroic, historically grounded Hoysala look.
